_comment: Owner switches. adsense.slots: the display ad unit IDs (digits only) for the three manual positions (top = first ad after the H1 and intro, mid = inside the content, end = after the content). Change them here only; AdSlot.astro reads them. An empty ID hides that slot. Auto ads stay under owner control in the AdSense UI (adsense-mobile 2026-11-02). support: the voluntary tip rails (Buy Me a Coffee primary, PayPal.Me secondary) used by SupportLine.astro and /support/.
